name: CDU TAFE tuition fee exemption for Centrelink recipients
summary: CDU TAFE students on a Centrelink or Veterans' Affairs payment, or holding humanitarian or refugee visas, pay no tuition on NT Government subsidised courses.
key: Students who receive a Centrelink or Veteran's Affairs payment will be exempt from paying tuition fees.
who: Receive a Centrelink or Veterans' Affairs payment
Hold a Permanent Resident Visa (Humanitarian) or Permanent Resident Visa (Refugee)
Some courses delivered in NT Remote 2 locations
how: Provide valid proof of concession at enrolment; contact Student Central about exemptions.
catches: Applies to NTG subsidised courses only.
Exemption applies from the teaching period the form is submitted if documents come late.

evidence.quote: students who receive a Centrelink or Veteran's Affairs payment will be exempt from paying tuition fees
An exemption applies to CDU TAFE tuition fees for NTG subsidised courses only.
To claim the fee exemption, a student must provide valid proof of concession at the time of enrolment, or fees will be charged.
